In the physical-minor alternative, conditioning on all other original coordinates, applying QFORM-DOUBLE-INCIDENT-RANK2-GROUPED-L3-v1, and then the dependence-safe outer square gives ||p_Q||_infinity<9.25/sqrt(|a| gamma).
If max_(k!=j) p_k^2<=1/2 on the left, then every non-anchor top-two-plane physical leverage is <1727/3225<0.535504; symmetrically on the right.
The universal arbitrary-dimensional quadratic-form bounded-density conjecture is not proved or disproved by this run.
